data.title: Papers on tool use in LLM agents

results.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
results.snippet: Language models exhibit remarkable abilities to solve new tasks from just a few examples or textual instructions, especially at scale. They also, paradoxically, struggle with basic functionality, such as arithmetic or factual lookup, where much simpler and smaller models excel. In this paper, we show that LMs can teach themselves to use external tools via simple APIs and achieve the best of both worlds.

results.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
results.snippet: We explore the use of LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner.
